## Which is this?

- [ ] Documentation, wording, or a failing test for an already-filed bug — no issue needed
- [ ] Code change linked to an issue labelled `accepting-work` — Fixes #

> Code changes without a linked `accepting-work` issue are closed unreviewed. That is not a
> judgement about the change; it means the approach has not been agreed yet, and an open PR
> without that agreement sits for months. Open an issue first.
